pdf_title: 107 registering an increase of 14·1 per cent. The maximum number police personnel injured were due to 'riotous mob' which accounted for 73·4 per cent of the total followed by 'injuries caused by criminals' (15·5 per cent) and 'accidents' (4.4 per cent). The pattern of the office held by the 'police personal injured' was almost similar to the pattern recorded under 'Police Personnel killed'. The maximum number injured were constables (74·8 per cent) followed by 'Head Constables (10·7 per cent), Assistant Sub-Inspector (2·2 per cent) and Sub-Inspector (7·9 per cent). During 1974 the percentage of gazetted rank injured was 1·9 in comparison to 4·8 per cent in 1973.
